symptom: `describe page` → `exec` over a Studio Pro page rewrites a text box's / text area's `SubmitBehaviour` WhileEditing → OnEndEditing (and `SubmitOnInputDelay` to 300) and a layout grid's `Width` FixedWidth → FullWidth, `mx check` clean (ako/mxcli-ledger FINDINGS #170). Worse, `check` passed `SubmitBehaviour: WhileEditing` (MDL-WIDGET07 is only a warning) and exec dropped it, and `Width: FixedWidth` on a layoutgrid drew not even the warning
cause: All four layers missing at once: the writer hard-coded the three values (widget_write.go TextBox, TextArea, LayoutGrid cases), sdk/pages had no field, describe neither read nor printed them, the builder consumed nothing. `Width` was silent because it sits in `staticWidgetKnownProps`, the cross-widget union, for the pixel widths of other widgets
insight: **Grep the writer for literal setter arguments** (`Set…("…")`, `Set…(300)`) — every one is a stored value MDL cannot express and a describe → exec reset waiting for a Studio Pro page that differs; PedApp already had both (FeedbackModule.ShareFeedback: three WhileEditing inputs; MyFirstModule.Home_Web: two FixedWidth grids), so the Studio Pro fixture is the test, no hand-patched BSON needed. **A key in the known-props union is not evidence it is consumed**: `Width` passed check for layoutgrid because image/container widths put it there. Keep a per-type key OUT of the union (exempt it per type like the #968 formatting keys, reading and emitting it from a file the vocabulary test does not scan) so the same key on another widget still warns. One validation function feeds builder, check (MDL-WIDGET18) and the sdk/pages canonicaliser feeds alter set, so the three cannot disagree. Revert proof: restoring the three hard-coded setters fails the PedApp round trip with exactly the reported WhileEditing → OnEndEditing / FixedWidth → FullWidth
